evidence: The bubbler containing bis(ethylcyclopentadienyl)ruthenium [Ru(C2H5C5H4)2; Ru(EtCp)2] liquid was heated at 80 °C to develop adequate vapor pressure while the delivery lines were heated to 100 °C to prevent condensation of the precursor. Ar gas with 99.999% purity was used as a carrier gas for the precursors.
